# Justy Media

> Justy Media is an automotive photography service and portfolio created by Andrew Ambrose in the Peak District, United Kingdom.

The site showcases automotive and editorial photography, explains available photography services, provides contact information, and offers free automotive phone wallpapers. Content is in English. Photographs and site content remain the property of Justy Media or their respective rights holders; this file is provided for discovery and does not grant additional usage rights.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.justymedia.co.uk/): Overview of Justy Media and recent work.
- [Photography portfolio](https://www.justymedia.co.uk/photography/): Entry point for automotive and editorial photography collections.
- [Automotive photography](https://www.justymedia.co.uk/photography/automotive-photography/): Vehicle photography galleries.
- [RUSH Magazine](https://www.justymedia.co.uk/photography/rush-magazine/): Editorial automotive work created for RUSH Magazine.
- [Services and pricing](https://www.justymedia.co.uk/services-pricing.html): Automotive photography packages and indicative prices.
- [About](https://www.justymedia.co.uk/about-us/): Background and history of Justy Media.
- [Contact](https://www.justymedia.co.uk/contact-us/): How to arrange a photography shoot.
- [Phone wallpapers](https://www.justymedia.co.uk/phone-wallpapers/): Free automotive wallpapers for personal devices.
